title: Lost badge replacement
script:
Woman: Excuse me, I lost my security badge this morning. Can I get a replacement?
Man: Sure. Do you remember your employee number?
Woman: It's 4482, I think.
Man: That's right. The replacement costs ten dollars, and it will be ready in about thirty minutes.
Woman: Ten dollars? That's more than I expected.
Man: It's company policy. You can pay at the desk, or the cost can be taken from your next paycheck.
translation:
女性:すみません、今朝セキュリティバッジをなくしてしまいました。再発行してもらえますか?
男性:もちろんです。社員番号は覚えていますか?
女性:たしか4482です。
男性:そのとおりです。再発行は10ドルで、30分ほどで用意できます。
女性:10ドル?思ったより高いわね。
男性:会社の規定なんです。受付で払うか、次の給与から差し引くこともできます。

questions.question: What did the woman lose?
choices: Her identification card
Her laptop bag
Her house keys
Her umbrella
questions.explanation: 女性は今朝、セキュリティバッジをなくしたと言っている。

questions.question: How long will the replacement take?
choices: Until tomorrow morning.
Approximately a half hour.
Two business days.
It can be done immediately at the desk.
questions.explanation: 男性は再発行は30分ほどで用意できると言っている。

questions.question: How can the woman pay for the replacement?
choices: Through an online bank transfer only.
It is free of charge.
At the front desk or through her next paycheck.
She must pay in cash to the security guard.
questions.explanation: 受付で払うか、次の給与から差し引くことができると言っている。

title: Airport shuttle timing
graphic:
Airport shuttle: weekday timetable
-----------------------------------
 Departs office    Arrives airport
 7:00 a.m.         7:40 a.m.
 9:00 a.m.         9:40 a.m.
 12:30 p.m.        1:10 p.m.
 3:00 p.m.         3:50 p.m.
script:
Man: The partners from Osaka land at half past one. Which shuttle should we book?
Woman: We should be at the airport at least twenty minutes before they land, to meet them at the gate.
Man: The nine o'clock shuttle would get there far too early.
Woman: The three o'clock one is too late. That leaves the lunchtime shuttle.
Man: Good. I'll book it and tell the partners to look for our driver at arrivals.
Woman: Also, let's leave the office by twelve thirty, so we don't miss the traffic.
translation:
男性:オーサカから来るパートナーは1時半に着陸する。どのシャトルを予約しようか?
女性:着陸の少なくとも20分前には空港にいて、ゲートで出迎えたいわ。
男性:9時のシャトルだと早すぎるね。
女性:3時のは遅すぎる。昼のシャトルしか残らないわね。
男性:いいね。それを予約して、パートナーには到着ロビーで運転手を探すように伝えよう。
女性:それと、渋滞を避けるために12時30分にはオフィスを出ておきましょう。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which shuttle should the speakers book?
choices: The one that leaves the office at 7:00 a.m.
The one that leaves the office at 9:00 a.m.
The one departing at 12:30 p.m.
The one that leaves the office at 3:00 p.m.
questions.explanation: 1時半の着陸の20分前に空港へ着くには、図表で1時10分に着く12時30分発が適している。

questions.question: Why is the nine o'clock shuttle not suitable?
choices: It is fully booked already.
It does not stop at the terminal.
It would reach the airport well before the partners land.
It takes longer than the others to reach the office.
questions.explanation: 男性は9時のシャトルだと早すぎると言っている。パートナーの着陸よりずっと前に空港に着いてしまう。

questions.question: What does the man plan to tell the partners?
choices: To take a taxi from the terminal.
To meet at the office first.
To search for the chauffeur near the arrivals hall.
To pay for the shuttle in advance.
questions.explanation: 男性は、到着ロビーで運転手を探すように伝えると言っている。

title: Recycling pickup change
script:
Man: Hi, Yuki, I heard the recycling pickup for our floor has been moved.
Woman: Yes, the city changed the schedule. Paper is now collected on Mondays instead of Thursdays.
Man: That's going to be a problem. Our copier paper boxes pile up over the weekend.
Woman: I thought of that. We could ask the cleaners to take the boxes down on Friday evening.
Man: Would they agree? They're already busy with the fourth floor.
Woman: The building manager said they can take on one more task if we pay the overtime fee.
Man: Then it's a small cost compared with having boxes blocking the hallway.
translation:
男性:やあ、ユキ。うちの階の資源ごみの回収日が変わったと聞いたよ。
女性:そうなの。市が日程を変えたのよ。紙類は木曜じゃなくて、今は月曜に回収されるわ。
男性:それは困るな。コピー用紙の箱が週末にたまってしまう。
女性:それは考えたわ。金曜の夕方に清掃スタッフに箱を下まで運んでもらうのはどうかしら。
男性:引き受けてくれるかな?4階の掃除でもう忙しそうだけど。
女性:ビル管理会社によると、残業代を払ってくれるなら、もう1つ仕事を引き受けられるそうよ。
男性:それなら、廊下に箱が積まれるのを防ぐ費用としては安いものだね。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "Then it's a small cost compared with having boxes blocking the hallway."?
choices: The cleaners should be paid more every month.
The extra charge is worth paying to avoid a mess.
The recycling schedule has been canceled.
The boxes should be moved to the basement.
questions.explanation: 残業代は、廊下に箱がふさがる状態を避けるための費用として安いと言っている。

questions.question: Why are the paper boxes a concern over the weekend?
choices: They will accumulate before the next pickup day.
The cleaners refuse to enter the floor.
The recycling bins are too small.
The city has raised its paper fee.
questions.explanation: 紙類の回収は月曜に変わったため、週末に箱がたまってしまうと男性は心配している。

questions.question: What will the woman most likely do next?
choices: Move the copier to another floor.
Call the city about the schedule.
Pay the overtime fee herself.
Arrange Friday evening pickups with the cleaners.
questions.explanation: 女性は金曜の夕方に清掃スタッフに箱を運んでもらう案を出しており、その手配を進めるとみられる。

title: Annual report draft deadline
script:
Man: Ellen, the annual report has to go to the board by Friday, but the finance numbers aren't final.
Woman: The auditors finished their review yesterday, so the numbers should be final soon.
Man 2: Not quite. They flagged a difference in the inventory total, and they need another day to check the warehouse counts.
Man: That means the board would see draft figures. Last year, that caused confusion for two months.
Woman: So we have two options: send the draft with a clear note, or ask the board to move the meeting to next week.
Man 2: The chairman won't move it. He's flying to Singapore on Monday.
Woman: Then the draft is our only option. We'll mark the inventory section as provisional so nobody uses it for decisions.
Man: I'd rather delay the whole report than publish numbers that might change. But I'll go along with your plan if the note is clear.
translation:
男性:エレン、年次報告書は金曜までに取締役会に出さないといけないけど、財務の数字がまだ確定していないんだ。
女性:監査は昨日終わったから、数字もまもなく確定するはずよ。
男性2:それがまだなんです。在庫の合計で食い違いが見つかって、倉庫の数量を確認するのにもう1日かかります。
男性:それだと取締役会は草案の数字を見ることになる。去年は同じことで2か月も混乱したんだ。
女性:だから選択肢は2つね。説明を付けて草案を送るか、取締役会を来週に延ばしてもらうか。
男性2:会長は延期に応じないと思います。月曜にシンガポールへ飛ぶので。
女性:じゃあ、草案を使うしかないわね。在庫の部分には暫定だと明記して、判断に使われないようにしましょう。
男性:変わるかもしれない数字を出すより、報告書全体を遅らせたいところだけど、明記してくれるなら君の案に従うよ。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "I'd rather delay the whole report than publish numbers that might change."?
choices: He thinks the auditors should finish sooner.
He would rather postpone the report than publish uncertain numbers.
He wants to fly to Singapore on Monday.
He believes the inventory total is already correct.
questions.explanation: まだ変わるかもしれない数字を出すくらいなら、報告書全体を遅らせたいと言っている。

questions.question: Why is the man worried about sending draft figures to the board?
choices: The chairman has refused to attend the meeting.
The auditors found a serious error in the accounts.
The report is too long for the board to read.
A similar problem confused the board for a long time last year.
questions.explanation: 男性は、去年も草案の数字で取締役会が2か月混乱したことを心配している。

questions.question: What will the group most likely do?
choices: Label part of the figures as preliminary in the document.
Move the board meeting to next week.
Ask the chairman to change his flight.
Send the report without any note.
questions.explanation: 取締役会の延期は応じられないと分かり、在庫の部分を暫定と明記した草案を送ることになる。

title: Conference keynote replacement
script:
Woman: Sam, the keynote speaker for the Tokyo conference just cancelled. Did you hear?
Man: Yes. The professor has a family emergency, so he can't travel next month.
Woman: We were going to ask Dr. Ueda to step in, but her topic is supply chains, and the afternoon panel already covers that.
Man: What about Mr. Takeda? He gave a good talk at last year's event.
Woman: He's available, but the organizers say he can only speak for fifteen minutes, not forty.
Man: Then a fifteen-minute slot won't work for the keynote.
Woman: Actually, Ms. Hoshino offered to present her new project. She would suit the opening slot better.
Man: Good. Let's confirm with her first, then decide.
Woman: I'll call her this afternoon and check her availability.
translation:
女性:サム、東京会議の基調講演者が急にキャンセルになったわ。聞いた?
男性:ああ。教授は家族の急用があって、来月は出張できないそうだ。
女性:ウエダ先生に代役を頼む予定だったけど、テーマがサプライチェーンで、午後のパネルと内容が重なってしまうの。
男性:じゃあ、タケダさんはどうかな?去年の会議で良い講演をしてくれたよね。
女性:空いているけど、主催者によると40分ではなく15分しか話せないそうよ。
男性:それだと基調講演には短すぎるね。
女性:実はホシノさんが、新しいプロジェクトの発表をしたいと申し出てくれたの。オープニングの枠のほうが合うと思う。
男性:いいね。まず彼女に確認して、それから決めよう。
女性:今日の午後に電話して、空いているか確認するわ。

questions.question: Who is most likely to give the opening talk?
choices: The professor who had to cancel.
A speaker who will talk about her newest project.
Dr. Ueda, who covers supply chains.
Mr. Takeda, in a fifteen-minute slot.
questions.explanation: 最初に挙がった2人は外れ、新しいプロジェクトを発表したいと申し出たホシノさんが有力になっている。

questions.question: Why was Dr. Ueda not chosen?
choices: Her subject would repeat the afternoon panel.
She is not available next month.
She asked for a higher fee.
She cancelled her flight to Tokyo.
questions.explanation: テーマがサプライチェーンで、午後のパネルと内容が重なるため外れた。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "She would suit the opening slot better."?
choices: Ms. Hoshino should be given a longer break.
Ms. Hoshino's talk fits better at the beginning of the event.
The opening slot should be moved to the afternoon.
Ms. Hoshino has already confirmed her time.
questions.explanation: ホシノさんの新しいプロジェクトの発表は、会議の始めの枠のほうが合うという意味である。

title: Office kitchen restock
script:
Woman: Jamal, the kitchen is almost out of coffee and tea bags.
Man: I ordered more on Monday. It should arrive on Wednesday.
Woman: Wednesday is too late. The sales team has a meeting tomorrow morning.
Man: Then I'll pick some up at the grocery store on my way in.
Woman: That would help. Get decaf coffee too, because Ms. Lin doesn't drink caffeine.
Man: Okay. I'll bring the receipt so you can add it to the petty cash record.
translation:
女性:ジャマル、キッチンのコーヒーと紅茶のティーバッグがほとんどないの。
男性:月曜に追加で注文したよ。水曜には届くはず。
女性:水曜では遅すぎるわ。営業チームが明日の朝に会議があるのよ。
男性:じゃあ、出社途中にスーパーで買ってくるよ。
女性:助かるわ。カフェインを飲まないリンさんがいるから、デカフェのコーヒーも買ってきて。
男性:わかった。レシートを持ち帰るから、小口現金の記録に入れておいてね。

questions.question: When will the new order arrive?
choices: Two days after Monday.
Tomorrow morning
Later today
Next Monday
questions.explanation: 男性は月曜に注文した品が水曜に届くと言っている。

questions.question: Why does the woman want decaf coffee?
choices: The decaf coffee is cheaper.
The sales team asked for it.
A coworker does not take stimulant drinks.
The machine only makes decaf.
questions.explanation: リンさんはカフェインを飲まないので、デカフェが必要だと女性は言っている。

questions.question: What will the man bring back?
choices: Some printer paper
A new coffee machine
A list of sales targets
Proof of purchase for the office accounts.
questions.explanation: 男性はレシートを持ち帰り、小口現金の記録に入れると言っている。

title: Customer survey regional scores
graphic:
Customer survey: satisfaction scores
-----------------------------------
 Region      Score (out of 10)   Responses
 North       8.4                 120
 South       7.1                  95
 East        6.5                  60
 West        8.9                 140
script:
Man: Ana, the survey results are in. Which region should we focus on first?
Woman: The West region is doing well, with the highest score. I'd rather look at the lowest one.
Man: South had the most complaints, but its score isn't the lowest.
Woman: True, but the South data came from many responses, so it's reliable.
Man: The East had only sixty responses, so the result might not be representative.
Woman: Then we should send a follow-up survey to the East customers and ask them about delivery times.
translation:
男性:アナ、顧客アンケートの結果が出たよ。まずどの地域に注力すべき?
女性:西地域は満足度が一番高くて好調ね。でも私は一番低いところを見たいわ。
男性:南は苦情が一番多かったけど、点数は最低ではないんだ。
女性:そうね。でも南は回答が多く集まったデータだから、信頼できるわ。
男性:東は回答が60件しかなかったから、結果が全体を代表していないかもしれない。
女性:それなら、東の顧客に追加のアンケートを送って、配送時間について聞きましょう。

questions.question: Look at the graphic. Which region did the woman want to follow up in?
choices: The western region
The southern region
The eastern region
The northern region
questions.explanation: 女性は一番低い点数の地域を見たいと言っており、図表で一番低いのは6.5の東である。

questions.question: Why is the man doubtful about the result for the East region?
choices: It was collected too late in the year.
The survey questions were changed midway.
The regional office is closed for repairs.
It is based on a small number of responses.
questions.explanation: 男性は東の回答が60件しかないので、全体を代表していないかもしれないと言っている。

questions.question: What does the woman suggest doing?
choices: Contacting East customers again for more feedback.
Raising prices in the West region.
Closing the East office.
Hiring more staff for the South.
questions.explanation: 東の顧客に追加のアンケートを送り、配送時間について聞くことを提案している。

title: Venue contract renewal
script:
Man: Rosa, the venue for our summer conference wants to renew the contract early.
Woman: That's a good sign, but I'm not sure we want the same hall for next year.
Man 2: Why not? The hall was rated highly by attendees last year.
Woman: True, but registrations are growing, and the hall can only fit four hundred people.
Man: We could ask for a discount if we sign a three-year deal.
Man 2: I'd check that first. The price for the second-floor rooms went up by fifteen percent last month.
Woman: Let's compare two other venues before we decide. Then we can negotiate with some leverage.
translation:
男性:ローザ、夏の会議の会場が契約を早めに更新したいと言ってきたよ。
女性:それは良い兆しだけど、来年も同じホールにするかは迷うわ。
男性2:なぜです?去年は参加者の評価が高かったホールですよね。
女性:そうなんだけど、申込人数が増えていて、ホールは400人しか入らないの。
男性:3年契約にするなら、値引きを頼めるかもしれないね。
男性2:まず確認したほうがいいです。先月、2階の部屋の料金が15%上がりましたから。
女性:決める前に、ほかの会場を2つ比べましょう。選択肢があれば交渉で有利になるわ。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "I'm not sure we want the same hall for next year."?
choices: She thinks attendees disliked the hall last year.
She is confident the price will stay the same.
She is hesitant to rebook the same venue.
She wants to sign a three-year contract right away.
questions.explanation: 来年も同じホールにするかは迷うと言っている。参加者の評価が高かったことは認めている。

questions.question: Why might the hall no longer be suitable?
choices: The hall is too far from the city center.
The number of registrations is growing beyond its capacity.
The catering service has become expensive.
Attendees complained about the parking.
questions.explanation: 申込人数が増えて、ホールの収容人数400人を超えそうだと女性は述べている。

questions.question: What will the group most likely do?
choices: Look at other venues before agreeing to renew.
Sign the three-year deal right away.
Pay the fifteen percent increase.
Move the conference to a larger hall.
questions.explanation: 女性は決める前に別の会場を2つ比べることを提案しており、男性2も確認を勧めている。

title: Catering vendor choice
script:
Man: We have two catering quotes for the employee party. Northfield is cheaper, but Harbor has better reviews.
Woman: Northfield had a problem at last year's event, though. The food arrived two hours late.
Man: That was their first time at such a large event, and they've since hired more staff.
Woman: I looked at their new contract. It says they will refund us only if the delay is caused by them.
Man: That's standard, isn't it? Every caterer writes it that way.
Woman: It is, but Harbor's contract covers traffic delays too, which matters since the venue is across town.
Man: So the extra cost might be worth it if we're worried about the schedule.
Woman: Exactly. And last year's party reviews say Harbor kept the food hot all evening.
translation:
男性:社員パーティーのケータリングは2社から見積もりが来ているよ。ノースフィールドは安いけど、ハーバーのほうが評判がいい。
女性:でもノースフィールドは去年のイベントでトラブルがあったでしょう。料理が2時間遅れて届いたのよ。
男性:あれは大きなイベントの初めての仕事だったし、その後はスタッフも増やしたそうだよ。
女性:新しい契約書を見たけど、遅れが向こうの責任の場合にしか返金しないと書いてあるの。
男性:それは普通だよね。どの業者も同じように書いているし。
女性:そうね、でもハーバーの契約は交通渋滞による遅れも対象になっているわ。会場が町の反対側だから重要よ。
男性:スケジュールが心配なら、少し高くても払う価値があるかもしれないね。
女性:まさにそうよ。それに去年のパーティーの評判では、ハーバーが夜通し料理を温かく保っていたとあったわ。

questions.question: What does the woman mean when she says, "It is, but Harbor's contract covers traffic delays too."?
choices: Harbor's contract is cheaper than Northfield's.
Traffic is never a concern for the venue.
Northfield's contract includes a free dessert.
Harbor offers better protection if the delivery is late.
questions.explanation: ハーバーの契約は交通渋滞による遅れも対象になっており、遅れに備えた保障がより手厚いという意味である。

questions.question: Why is the man willing to pay more for Harbor?
choices: The party's timing could be at risk with the cheaper vendor.
Harbor has a bigger kitchen than Northfield.
Northfield's staff have refused to work at night.
Harbor offers a free dessert with every order.
questions.explanation: スケジュールが心配なら、少し高くても払う価値があると男性は言っている。

questions.question: Which caterer will the group most likely choose?
choices: Northfield, since refunds are standard in every contract.
Harbor, because its contract covers more kinds of delay.
Neither, because the party may be canceled.
A third caterer that has not been mentioned yet.
questions.explanation: 遅れへの保障と去年の評判を踏まえると、ハーバーに決まる可能性が高い。

title: Company dinner date change
script:
Woman: The company dinner was supposed to be on Friday the fourteenth, but the venue just cancelled that date.
Man: Their ballroom is being used for a wedding. What dates do they have left?
Woman 2: They offered Saturday the fifteenth, but half of the event team is working a trade show that weekend.
Woman: Right. Could we move it to Thursday the twentieth instead?
Man: That's when the finance department closes the quarter. They asked us not to hold events that week.
Woman: Then how about the following Friday, the twenty-first? The venue said it's open that night.
Woman 2: I just heard the head office's visitors have moved to the twenty-eighth, so the twenty-first is clear now.
Man: Then the twenty-first works. Let's book it before the venue gives it away.
Woman: I'll confirm it with the venue this afternoon.
translation:
女性:社員の夕食会は14日の金曜の予定だったけど、会場がその日を急にキャンセルしてきたの。
男性:あそこのホールは結婚式に使われるんだって。ほかにどの日程が空いているの?
女性2:15日の土曜を提案されたけど、その週末はイベントチームの半分がトレードショーに出ているの。
女性:そうね。じゃあ、木曜の20日にずらせないかしら。
男性:20日は経理部が四半期を締める時期だよ。その週はイベントを入れないでほしいと言われている。
女性:それなら、次の金曜、21日はどう?会場はその夜も空いているそうよ。
女性2:さっき聞いたんだけど、本社の来訪者の日程が28日に変わったの。だから21日は空いたわ。
男性:それなら21日でいこう。会場に取られる前に押さえよう。
女性:今日の午後に会場に確認するわ。

questions.question: When will the company dinner most likely be held?
choices: On Saturday the fifteenth.
On Thursday the twentieth.
On Friday the fourteenth.
On the Friday a week after the original date.
questions.explanation: 最初の14日はキャンセルされ、15日と20日も外れ、最終的に一週間後の21日の金曜に決まっている。

questions.question: Why was the Thursday option rejected?
choices: The venue has already been booked that day.
Finance is busy closing the books that week.
Saturday is reserved for staff training.
The CEO is traveling that week.
questions.explanation: 20日の週は経理部が四半期を締める時期で、イベントを避けるよう言われている。

questions.question: What does the man mean when he says, "Let's book it before the venue gives it away."?
choices: They should wait for the venue to lower its price.
The venue is likely to cancel again.
They must ask the CEO to change the date.
They should reserve the date quickly before someone else takes it.
questions.explanation: 会場が別の人に押さえられる前に、早く予約しようという意味である。
